nodes.label: P7.1: plantillas, variables y audiencia
nodes.rationale: Complete Meta template status/catalog, variables, audience and accurate preview counts. Recipient import is required only where the inspected reference supports it.

nodes.label: P7.2: consentimiento, cadencia y pausa
nodes.rationale: Recipients and scheduling require consent, exclusions, cadence and pause. All blocked transport boundaries must be replaced together by transactional validation.

nodes.label: P7.3: una outbox con frontera final
nodes.rationale: Reuse the sole outbox and qualify leases, retries, cancellation, uncertain results, reconciliation and immediate validation before sending.

nodes.label: P7.4: reporte y reintento selectivo
nodes.rationale: Report pending, accepted, sent, delivered, read and failed separately; export and selectively retry without reusing accepted jobs.

nodes.label: Cierre y reversión de P7
nodes.rationale: Consent revoked after preparation must prevent POST. Reversal pauses campaign/transport, retains outbox and receipts, and reconciles unknown effects before retry.

nodes.label: P7 inicial: 38,57% y sin aceptación
nodes.rationale: The initial ledger records technical work 27/70 = 38.57% and 0/5 accepted criteria, with P2/P3/P4 dependencies. This extraction assigns no acceptance.

nodes.label: P4: aceptación externa pendiente
nodes.rationale: P6 local closure records zero real provider calls and P4 still awaiting real domains/apps. Synthetic catalogs or receipts cannot satisfy external acceptance.

nodes.label: Checkpoint P6 protegido
nodes.rationale: The P6 checkpoint uses its own database CBN_P6ES_TRIAL_20261027_a6fc321d, profile, image and volume. Its 153 tables, 249 FKs, empty 30-table academic partition and earlier checkpoints are documented context, not a database read by this reviewer.

nodes.label: Campañas heredadas requieren composición anterior
nodes.rationale: CampaignService requires local_sql_copy mode, crm_marketing.contract marker and the previous sql_workspace/channel_store composition. It is not the native institutional P6 service.

nodes.label: DTO educativos con revisión y fechaUTC
nodes.rationale: BroadcastWrite bounds name/template/segment/interval/daily limit; scheduling requires an offset and normalizes UTC. Segment keeps academic program, period, stage and schedule distinct.

nodes.label: CatálogoMeta paginado y versionado existente
nodes.rationale: Explicit sync reads WABA and token from a legacy single-channel account, fetches up to five pages/500 templates and versions content separately from status updates.

nodes.label: Plantilla vigente ligada a cuenta/revisión
nodes.rationale: template_binding requires the current approved version, synchronization time and matching account revision/WABA. It does not make operator approval equivalent to provider approval.

nodes.label: Oferta/jornada académica legada no es catálogo P6
nodes.rationale: Legacy programs() and offer/period/schedule checks use academic SIIE authority. Native P6 has a declared CRM catalog and no academic read grants, so P7 needs an explicit catalog adapter.

nodes.label: Audiencia por identidad externa explícita
nodes.rationale: Audience uses explicitly linked external identity, contact, conversation and account; it filters segment/account and blocks human control, closure, no-contact and missing consent. TOP501 rejects scopes over500 rather than proving paginated counts.

nodes.label: Consentimiento marketing versionado y vigente
nodes.rationale: Latest consent is selected by identity, channel, account scope and marketing purpose. Missing, non-granted, future or expired decisions block; a phone number is not consent.

nodes.label: No contactar respeta historial de contacto fusionado
nodes.rationale: no_contact obtains historical_ids for the contact and checks noContact=true on evaluation plans belonging to conversations of those historical contacts. Merged contacts retain this conservative exclusion.

nodes.label: Editar/pausar cambia revisión y epoch
nodes.rationale: Edits are limited to draft/paused campaigns, reset draft and increment revision/inclusion epoch. Pause also advances the epoch and cancels only recipients without QueueId; it does not yet cancel C10 SendJob.

nodes.label: Preparación guarda evidencia sin encolar
nodes.rationale: Preparation records consent/account/campaign/control revisions, inclusion epoch and input sequence, then stores blocked recipients. marketing_transport_disabled remains and no message/outbox job is created.

nodes.label: Cadencia por cuenta ya modelada
nodes.rationale: AccountCadence stores interval, daily limit, reservation window, next-allowed time, revision and lease per channel/account scope. Campaign scheduling/template/state constraints are explicit.

nodes.label: Worker de evaluación no es dispatcher
nodes.rationale: process_one leases EvaluationRun and evaluates/prepares risk or remarketing without sending. Cooldown uses prior preparation time; actual time in CRM stage remains unknown.

nodes.label: Detalle agregado limitado ysinexport/retry
nodes.rationale: Legacy list/detail aggregates Status and returns at most200 recipients. It has no native C10 paginated report, CSV export, selective retry or C10 receipt linkage here.

nodes.label: Activación heredada siempre423
nodes.rationale: activate/start/send always call transport_disabled and return423. Removing only one route guard does not complete the transport contract.

nodes.label: Dos fronteras heredadas rechazan marketing
nodes.rationale: The B011 worker invokes reject_marketing before normal sending and media_frontier. The guard rejects marketing/campaign/remarketing/broadcast origins and queues linked to CampaignRecipient.

nodes.label: Un solo worker C10 actual
nodes.rationale: Current Workers runs EventWorker, MediaWorker, one Dispatcher and maintenance. It starts neither CampaignWorker nor B011 dispatcher; P7 must retain one emitter.

nodes.label: API actual no monta broadcasting
nodes.rationale: core_permission has no campaign/broadcast classification and defaults to self; current create_app mounts only P4/P5/P6 and a404 catchall. P7 routes need explicit permission, module and profile binding.

nodes.label: Permiso institucional campaigns.manage ya existe
nodes.rationale: broadcasts/campaigns modules and campaigns.manage already exist independently of subscriptions. Declaring them does not itself mount routes or authorize transport.

nodes.label: InstitutionShell aún no monta el panel de campañas
nodes.rationale: Navigation names both sections, but without a P7 operation branch the actual InstitutionShell shows integration pending. The legacy panel does not demonstrate functionality in the current4178 preview.

nodes.label: Panel legado mezcla preparación/riesgo/reglas/plantillas
nodes.rationale: The old panel preserves drafts, evaluates/prepares without delivery, explicitly synchronizes Meta and displays real audience exclusions. Its /api/v1/campaigns/broadcasts transport needs a native institutional client.

nodes.label: Credenciales C10 por IntegrationId
nodes.rationale: provider_account validates provider, asset and API version, rejects demo egress, and resolves vault credentials by IntegrationId. External phone ID and parent WABA ID are distinct.

nodes.label: Enqueue nativo crea ProviderOperation+SendJob
nodes.rationale: enqueue creates one pending ProviderOperation and one queued SendJob for an exact IntegrationId, kind, identity/message or comment. It captures the current actor/session.

nodes.label: Idempotencia actual es por intención de un destinatario
nodes.rationale: RequestDigest covers integration, payload and resource IDs; existing operation returns its QueueId. This helper does not compare ActorRef or include actor in that digest, so P7 API must retain actor-bound institutional replay. Campaign-level operation IDs cannot be reused for every recipient.
nodes.integration_gap: Una operación de campaña no se reutiliza comoOperationId de cada destinatario; vincular efecto/recipient/attempt estable para no duplicar.

nodes.label: Contrato de SendJob: chat o comentario
nodes.rationale: The frozen P6 model requires chat with identity/message or comment_reply with a comment. Composite FKs bind account, identity, operation and reservation. No SendJob State enum check appears in the inspected model subset; transitions are enforced in code.

nodes.label: Destinatario/consentimiento apuntan a B011
nodes.rationale: Legacy recipient/consent IdentityId references CRMIdentidadExterna; recipient QueueId references CRMColaSalida. Legacy recipient Status excludes accepted/retried. C10 IDs cannot simply be stored in these columns.

nodes.label: Política actual: texto humano en ventana de 24 horas
nodes.rationale: ready validates account/actor and exact message-route-identity ownership, requires an open conversation under human control and an incoming message within24hours. This is a service-text policy, not approved-template marketing outside that window.

nodes.label: Autoridad cola requiere sesión eInbox.write
nodes.rationale: actor_allowed requires a current session/auth version, active user/role, inbox.write and enabled inbox/channels modules. P7 needs marketing authority without broadening old human chat authority.

nodes.label: El adaptador actual sólo mandaWhatsApptexto
nodes.rationale: providers.send currently builds WhatsApp type=text, with no template branch. Stored ComponentsJson alone does not render validated template parameters or justify sending free text.
nodes.integration_gap: No cambiar una plantilla por texto libre para evitar la política del proveedor.

nodes.label: before_send está condicionado al perfil/origen
nodes.rationale: Dispatcher.frontier rechecks ready immediately before effect, but callback forwarding is limited to media or P5/P6 profiles. The provider helper invokes it only for bot origin/controlEpoch. P7 needs an explicit immediate template-effect frontier.

nodes.label: Reserva técnica durable independiente de billing
nodes.rationale: Institutional daily-message and per-integration TikTok limits use durable QuotaBucket/QuotaReservation. Zero blocks and reservations count. Marketing cadence must coexist with this accounting, not create another sender.

nodes.label: Lease vencido conserva incertidumbre
nodes.rationale: Expired sending leases make SendJob, ProviderOperation and reservation uncertain without automatic requeue. A crashed POST may already have executed.

nodes.label: POSTaceptado no significa entregado
nodes.rationale: Only a valid provider ExternalId confirms accepted. Known failures become failed and ambiguous results uncertain; reservations are committed, released or retained accordingly. Provider delivery receipts remain separate evidence.

nodes.label: Recibo verificado se enruta por teléfono exacto
nodes.rationale: EventWorker consumes verified encrypted receipts bound to endpoint/application/integration. WhatsApp routes by phone_number_id, not WABA/channel name; dedupe is account-scoped and content-based.

nodes.label: Proyección de estados monotónica
nodes.rationale: delivery orders accepted/sent/delivered/read and does not downgrade delivered/read to failed. Status projection updates SendJob by exact integration/external ID, not invented recipient delivery.

nodes.label: Recibo adelantado puede quedar sin proyección
nodes.rationale: A status with zero matching ExternalId rows causes no error and project_once marks its event processed. If the receipt precedes POST acceptance commit, ExternalId can still beNULL. Durable unmatched-receipt reconciliation needs qualification.
nodes.integration_gap: Prueba de reciboantesdelarespuesta yreplay/dedupe:preservar evidencia yproyectar al confirmar mapping sinotroPOST.

nodes.label: Reintento manual sólo para fallo conocido
nodes.rationale: recover_send requires failed SendJob and failed ProviderOperation, row version and recent reauthorization. It creates a new attempt, marks the old job retried and retargets MessageRoute; it does not reset uncertain or accepted jobs.

nodes.label: Reintento tras fallo informado por recibo
nodes.rationale: The generic helper requires ProviderOperation.failed. A provider-accepted POST with a subsequent failed receipt can still have ProviderOperation.confirmed; P7 must define receipt-backed retry policy and never reuse an accepted job.

nodes.label: Abandonarincierto conserva intento ycuota
nodes.rationale: Recovery uses actor-bound replay and recent authorization. Abandoning uncertain cancels the historical job and marks the operation abandoned, without resend or erasing a possibly charged quota.

nodes.label: Mantenimiento mantiene incertidumbre ypurga controlada
nodes.rationale: Maintenance preserves ambiguous operations, expires OAuth/media processing, and purges retained raw receipt bodies only under its policy. Reports/audit should not rely on raw content after retention expiry.

nodes.label: Referencia soporta crear/syncMeta ycomponentes
nodes.rationale: The reference supports template name/language/category, body, header/footer/media, buttons and allow_category_change. Its patch DTO also accepts status/quality/rejection.

nodes.label: Referencia renderiza variables nombradas ynuméricas
nodes.rationale: Reference helpers render named/numeric variables and body parameters from conversation data. CBN should use a closed permitted mapping and must not invent or disclose academic/private attributes.

nodes.label: Referencia preview cuenta y muestra muestra
nodes.rationale: Reference preview counts total audience and renders up to10 sample rows. Sample size is distinct from total or consent-eligible counts.

nodes.label: Estado «approved» local de Scentra
nodes.rationale: Reference patch can write approved locally. This action is not positive evidence of Meta approval and must not fabricate approved templates for CBN.

nodes.label: Referencia encola pero depende deSaaS
nodes.rationale: Reference enqueue uses privileged SaaS roles, commercial quota checks and PostgreSQL message/outbound/recipient writes. process_now may call its dispatcher directly; this is a feature reference, not a portable C10 router.

nodes.label: Reporte yCSVexisten; noimportCSVobservado
nodes.rationale: Reference provides filtered/paginated status reporting and CSV export. No recipient-import route/control was observed in the inspected broadcast router, schemas or panel; that finding is bounded to this corpus.

nodes.label: RetrySaaSreencola failed enlamismaoutbox
nodes.rationale: Reference retry-failed resets the same outbound status/attempts and optionally dispatches immediately. CBN should preserve attempts and retry only known effects through the sole C10 emitter.

nodes.label: Dependencias SaaS comerciales no son contrato educativo
nodes.rationale: Reference AGENTS documents feature/billing/message quotas, encrypted tokens and idempotency. The authorized educational adaptation removes plans while retaining technical availability, limits, secrets and effect controls.

nodes.label: Pruebas P4 deidentidad yrecibos existen
nodes.rationale: Inspected P4 test sources assert routing by phone, monotonic delivery and ignored invented status. They are neither P7 execution nor tests run by this reviewer.

nodes.label: Fronteras de calificación P7
nodes.rationale: P7 qualification must cover consent revoked after preparation, pause at the final frontier, cadence/reservations, concurrency, restart, unknown results, early receipts, selective retry and reporting. Controlled fixtures do not close P4 external acceptance.

hyperedges.label: Una frontera autorizada antes del POST
hyperedges.rationale: Template/account identity, current consent/no-contact, campaign epoch, cadence, quota and current actor must converge immediately before one provider effect; service-chat controls must remain intact.

hyperedges.label: Recibos, estados y recuperación
hyperedges.rationale: Reports, dedupe, early receipts, selective retries and recovery must retain durable evidence and distinguish provider acceptance from delivery.

hyperedges.label: Integración P7 con preservación de P6
hyperedges.rationale: An isolated native P7 profile/contract can reuse educational domain logic without redirecting P6/SIIE, enabling the legacy worker or asserting missing external P4 acceptance.

execution_claim: Static baseline source extraction only; no SQL, UI, provider calls or P7 acceptance.
